In the samples CISA analyzed, a malicious Excel file, Cooperation terms.xls, contained macros written in Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) and two encoded Windows Script Files. The collected data is then hex-encoded and sent to an adversary-controlled IP address via an HTTP POST request.
